recentItems.title: Lucky Daye Creates Beautiful Visuals With His Vocals on "Nowhere Fast" | VISIONARIES PERFORMANCE
recentItems.description:
R&B singer and songwriter Lucky Daye steps onto the VISIONARIES XR stage for a unique performance of his new song "Nowhere Fast." The screen behind him includes a one of a kind technology that's reactive to Lucky's movements and vocals so the entire visual is being created in real time as he sings. Welcome to VISIONARIES.

recentItems.title: The rap x hardcore crossover is becoming a necessity
Becky G Explains Her Decision That Changed Everything
recentItems.description:
During the latest episode of Visionaries Moments, Becky G talks about the decision to sing an all spanish song and how "Sola" changed the course of her career. She also spoke about how collaborations with Bad Bunny, Peso Pluma and more helped confirm her decision as the right one. Becky G's new album Baraja Bendita is the most authentic version of who she is artistically yet. Becky makes it clear that following your intuition will always lead you down the right path.

recentItems.title: We Made Adria Arjona Pick: Kendrick Lamar vs Bad Bunny, Beyoncé vs Selena & More | Sound Check
recentItems.description:
Actress Adria Arjona stops by Soundcheck to face a series of tough decisions between some of her favorite artists and songs. Adria is the star of A24's new movie Onslaught, so she has to pick between some scenarios her character faces in the movie.

Host Jeremy Hecht puts her to the test in this music game show, asking her to compare different songs and choose a winner for each scenario.
